race.comment: LILI ANNA (9) is improving with racing and looks to be building up to a maiden victory. Drawn to receive all the favours and shapes as one of the hardest to beat. DARK MODE (1) hit the frame on debut and will have taken benefit from that day at the races. Worth including. PHOENIX LEGEND (6) will be rock-hard fit for this and looks one for the multiples. DARK MODE (1) was solid on debut and with natural improvement has to come right into the mix.
